newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: French minister confident about qualifying for EMU.
newsitem.headline: French minister confident about qualifying for EMU.

text.p: French Budget Minister Alain Lamassoure said on Monday he was confident that France would qualify on time for European economic and monetary union (EMU).
"France will qualify," he told reporters after talks in The Hague with Dutch Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm.

Lamassoure said France's 1996 budget results had been in line with government projections, adding that the 1997 budget had been based on a reduction in the public sector deficit to the EMU target level of three percent of gross domestic product.
"The latest forecasts for economic growth we have confirm our conviction that this target will be attained," he said.
